mapper.select: SELECT * FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId}) AND sender_id != receiver_id ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId}) AND sender_id != receiver_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (order_id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, is_read) VALUES (#{orderId}NULL, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{isRead}0)
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT latest.peer_id AS peerId, u.nickname AS peerNickname, u.avatar AS peerAvatar, m.content AS lastContent, m.create_time AS lastTime, COALESCE(uc.unread_count, 0) AS unreadCount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END AS peer_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId}) AND sender_id != receiver_id GROUP BY peer_id ) latest JOIN message m ON m.id = latest.max_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = latest.peer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sender_id AS peer_id, COUNT(*) AS unread_count FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY sender_id ) uc ON uc.peer_id = latest.peer_id ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = #{peerId}) OR (sender_id = #{peerId} AND receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND sender_id = #{peerId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = #{peerId}) OR (sender_id = #{peerId} AND receiver_id = #{userId})
DELETE FROM message WHERE id = #{id} AND receiver_id = #{userId}
